build_BaseModel_subclass: build a subclass of BaseModel that implements _build and forward methods for custom model integration
create_BaseModel_init: create a BaseModel instance by passing config and global_config DictConfig objects to the constructor
test_BaseModel_build: test the BaseModel build method which calls _build and sets inference mode to False
refactor_BaseModel_inference: refactor the BaseModel inference method to toggle training mode and propagate inferencing flag to all submodules
review_BaseModel_train: review the BaseModel train method that sets inferencing to False on all modules and calls parent train
